mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level (FEDFUNDS) is associated with higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced discount rates and increased liquidity in financial markets.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate a broad-based economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate investment and consumer demand weaken.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising for 3 consecutive months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to higher borrowing costs and reduced corporate investment.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered tightening cycles, or the Rank IC for the trigger condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of real GDP (GDPC1) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as strong economic growth supports corporate earnings and investor confidence.
failure_condition: Rank IC between GDPC1 and 60-day SPX returns is negative or below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year inflation rate exceeding 3.0% (CPIAUCSL YoY change) signals central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to increased real interest rates and reduced equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent slowing job growth (PAYEMS) and declining retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate revenue growth stalls.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both PAYEMS growth slows and RSAFS declines, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market downturn (HOUST below 1400.0), S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and construction sector weakness impacting broader economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is below 1400.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.
